name: cms-content-branches
_comment: DRAFT — not applied yet. Spike artefact for the preview-pr-mimicry exploration (see docs/preview-pr-ruleset-spike.md). The existing cms-feature-branches.json ruleset already covers refs/heads/cms/** with non_fast_forward, pull_request (squash/merge, 0 reviewers), and validate-content as a required check — the issue #79 fix. The ONLY delta this ruleset adds is `deletion` protection: if/when long-lived cms/<slug> draft branches start carrying their own preview environments à la preview-pr-<N>, Decap relies on the branch existing while the draft is open, and accidental deletion would orphan the in-flight draft. Apply via `gh api -X POST repos/Adam-S-Daniel/adamdaniel.ai/rulesets --input .github/rulesets/cms-content-branches.json` once the user buys in. Intentionally NOT promoting `pull_request` (Decap commits per keystroke via the Contents API — blocking direct writes here would break the editor) and NOT promoting the full required_status_checks list from main.json (`e2e (1)` / `finalize` etc. on every Save would burn ~7 min of CI per keystroke).
